title: The roll threshold shown in an action's menu label routinely does not match the DC used when it resolves, always a few points lower than the real DC. E.g. 'force the strongbox (might) (roll 7+...)' resolved as 'vs DC 10'; 'win his debt clear at the ring (might) (roll 8+...)' resolved as 'vs DC 11'; 'press him on the Hundred (will) (roll 10+...)' resolved as 'vs DC 12'. Seen repeatedly across many different checks all game.
where: many rooms, e.g. Elder's House / The Muster Ground (Thornwold) / The Ironbound Chapterhouse
